Title: Create shift API
Description: Implement API endpoint for managers to create a shift with date; time; location; and capacity

Title: Edit shift API
Description: Implement API endpoint for managers to update an existing shift's details

Title: Delete shift API
Description: Implement API endpoint for managers to delete a shift

Title: View all shifts (manager)
Description: Allow managers to view all shifts across all dates in a calendar view

Title: View available open shifts (bartender)
Description: Allow bartenders to browse open shifts they can sign up for

Title: Sign up for a shift
Description: Allow bartenders to sign up for an open shift that has remaining capacity

Title: View my upcoming shifts
Description: Allow bartenders to see a list of their upcoming assigned shifts

Title: Cancel shift signup
Description: Allow bartenders to cancel their signup for a future shift

Title: View past completed shifts
Description: Allow bartenders to view their past shifts that have been completed

Title: Shift state: open to full transition
Description: Automatically transition a shift from open to full when all capacity slots are taken

Title: Shift state: full to open transition
Description: Transition shift back to open when a bartender cancels and capacity becomes available

Title: Shift state: derived running state
Description: Implement derived running state: add start_at (timestamptz) to the DBShift TypeScript type; create a computeEffectiveState(shift) pure utility that returns 'running' when start_at <= now() and stored state is 'open' or 'full'; apply it in the GET shifts handler before returning the response. The DB state column is never written with 'running' — no cron; no Edge Function. Prerequisite for TSK-SHF-014.

Title: Shift state: running to closed transition
Description: Transition shift to closed when a report is submitted. End time passing does not auto-close — a shift stays running until a report is filed. BLOCKED: depends on reports domain (not yet started).

Title: Prevent signup for non-open shifts
Description: Block bartenders from signing up for shifts that are full; running; or closed. The signup guard must use computeEffectiveState (not the raw DB state column) so shifts whose start_at has passed are correctly treated as running. Blocked by TSK-SHF-012.

Title: Prevent suspended users from signing up
Description: Block suspended users from signing up for any shift

Title: Write feature tests for shift management
Description: Create unit tests covering all shift management flows

Title: API: remove bartender from shift
Description: Implement API endpoint (DELETE /api/shifts/[id]/bartenders/[userId]) allowing managers to remove a registered bartender from a shift's assignment list. Removal only — manual assignment by managers is v.2. NOTE: implemented against JSONB schema — will require update as part of TSK-SHF-020.

Title: UI: bartender list management in shift edit dialog
Description: Extend the shift edit dialog to display the list of currently registered bartenders with a remove button per bartender; only shown to managers; only for shifts that are open or full. No add/assign UI — removal only in v.1.

Title: UI: shift detail popup from My Shifts page
Description: Add a detail link on each shift row in the My Shifts page that opens the same shift detail popup used in the shifts calendar; reusing the existing popup component

Title: Migrate bartender assignments from JSONB to join table
Description: Replace shifts.bartenders jsonb with a shift_assignments(shift_id; user_id; created_at) join table. Includes: DBA migration file; backfill from existing data; FK constraints; indexes; updates to all four shifts/users API routes; two component reads; and test helper fixtures. Must be completed before reports domain implementation begins.
